dex.entry: A small grey moth whose wing-eyes were once luminous but are now flat and lightless — ashen circles where the glow used to be. It flutters through coldfog seeking the warmth it can no longer feel. A moth whose eye-spots have gone dark — instantly melancholy, immediately recognisable.
